structure: Extract of the Maine Learning Results 2019 Social Studies standards, Geography strand only. Pages 1-4 repeat the front matter of the full standards (Introduction, Guiding Principles, skills, key ideas, enduring themes, eras table, statutes). Then a strand heading ("Geography"), and for each grade level (Kindergarten, 1st..5th, 6-8th, 9th-Diploma) a block of "Grade Level: X", "Standard: ...", and "Performance Expectation: ..." as paragraph units. K-5 expectations are numbered (Geography 1, 2, ...); 6-8 and 9-Diploma are split into Foundational (F1..) and Developmental (D1..) items. Asterisk (*) marks Guiding Principles. 9th-Diploma = grades 9-12. Running header "Strand: Geography" in page markers.
